# Intro and User Input

This workflow performs drug target set enrichment analysis (DTSEA) on paired-
sample high-throughput compound screening data. It is intended for studies with
two phenotype groups and multiple sample columns defined in a metadata
workbook. If this is not the case, the single-sample analysis workflow should
be used instead.

The main user-supplied input for the workflow is a multi-sheet Excel workbook.
The first sheet contains analysis metadata and run settings, including the
analysis name, output directory, mapping library path, and statistical tests to
be run. The mapping library path should point to a drug-target mapping file in
the [.GMT format.](https://docs.gsea-msigdb.org/#GSEA/Data_Formats/) The second
sheet contains the experimental abundance matrix, with sample columns matching
the metadata sheet exactly and in the same order. Rows should represent
abundance values for individual screening compounds.

The workflow writes results to a timestamped subdirectory under the user-
specified root directory. Outputs include result tables and summary plots for
comparing enrichment results across methods and allowing users to identify
high-priority drug targets.

To run the workflow, edit the `data_sheet` value in the `Input Data` chunk so
that it points to your Excel workbook. The rest of the code can usually be run
without modification.

```{r Input Data}
## ENTER THE PATH FOR THE USER DATA HERE
data_sheet <- "Example_Paired_Data.xlsx"
```

# Automated workflow
## Read in data and organize for downstream analysis

```{r Organize Data Structures}
metadata <- readxl::read_excel(data_sheet, sheet = 1, col_names = FALSE)
data <- readxl::read_excel(data_sheet, sheet = 2)
colnames(metadata)[1] <- "Static"

metadata_categories <- c("Analysis_Name","Root_Directory","Transformations",
                         "Mapping_Library","Tests")

metadata_list <- lapply(metadata_categories, function(x) {
  metadata |>
    dplyr::filter(Static == x) |>
    dplyr::pull(2)
})
names(metadata_list) <- metadata_categories

path <- paste0(
  metadata_list["Root_Directory"],
  "/",
  metadata_list["Analysis_Name"],
  "_",
  format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M")
)

gmt.file <- file.path(metadata_list["Mapping_Library"])
gs <- EnrichmentBrowser::getGenesets(gmt.file)
gs <- lapply(gs, function(x) {
  x <- x[which(x != "")]
})

if (!dir.exists(path)) {
  dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  if (!dir.exists(path)) {
    stop("Unable to create output directory. Check that the root directory exists and is writable.")
  }
  knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = path)
  setwd(path)
} else {
  stop("Analysis would overwrite existing data, choose another analysis name or delete old analyses")
}

compoundColumn <- metadata |>
  dplyr::filter(Static %in% c("Column", "Type")) |>
  t() |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  stats::setNames(c("Column", "Type")) |>
  dplyr::slice(-c(1)) |>
  dplyr::filter(Type == "Compound") |>
  dplyr::pull(Column)

if (length(compoundColumn) == 0) {
  stop("No compound column was specified in the metadata. Please mark exactly one column with Type = 'Compound'.")
}

if (length(compoundColumn) > 1) {
  stop("Multiple compound columns specified in data, please choose only one and ensure the rest are abundance values")
}

data_numeric <- data |>
  dplyr::select(-tidyselect::all_of(compoundColumn)) |>
  as.matrix()

utils::write.table(
  data_numeric,
  "exprs.tab",
  sep = "\t",
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = FALSE,
  quote = FALSE
)

columnMeta <- metadata |>
  dplyr::filter(Static %in% c("Column", "Type", "Phenotype")) |>
  t() |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  stats::setNames(c("Column", "Type", "Phenotype")) |>
  dplyr::slice(-c(1)) |>
  dplyr::filter(Type == "Sample") |>
  dplyr::select(-2) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Phenotype = as.numeric(Phenotype))

utils::write.table(
  columnMeta,
  "colnames.tab",
  sep = "\t",
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = FALSE,
  quote = FALSE
)

rownamesDF <- data |>
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(compoundColumn)) |>
  as.matrix()

utils::write.table(
  rownamesDF,
  "rownames.tab",
  sep = "\t",
  row.names = FALSE,
  col.names = FALSE,
  quote = FALSE
)
```

## Execute statistical tests and store results

```{r Run tests}
if(metadata_list["Tests"]=="all") {
  test_list <- c("gsea","padog","globaltest","camera",
                 "safe","gsa","samgs","roast","gsva")
}else {
  test_list <-  trimws(strsplit(metadata_list["Tests"], ",")[[1]])
}

se <- EnrichmentBrowser::readSE("exprs.tab", "colnames.tab", "rownames.tab")
se <- EnrichmentBrowser::deAna(se, padj.method = "BH")


EnrichmentBrowser::configEBrowser(key="GS.MIN.SIZE", value=3)
results_list <- lapply(test_list,
                       function(x) {
                         EnrichmentBrowser::sbea(method = x, se = se, gs = gs)
                       })

save(file = paste0(metadata_list["Analysis_Name"],"_results.Rda"), results_list)

```

## Assemble and export results tables

```{r Tables}
for(i in 1:length(results_list)) {
  xlsx::write.xlsx(results_list[[i]]$res.tbl,
                   paste0(metadata_list["Analysis_Name"],"_results.xlsx"),
                   sheetName = test_list[i],append=TRUE)
}

rankings <- lapply(results_list,EnrichmentBrowser::gsRanking,signif.only=FALSE)
names(rankings) <- test_list

rankings <- lapply(rankings, function(x) {
  x<-as.data.frame(x)
})

resultDF<-rankings |>
  dplyr::bind_rows(.id = "test") |>
  dplyr::select(c(test, GENE.SET, PVAL))

allPvals <- resultDF |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = GENE.SET,
    names_from = test,
    values_from = PVAL,
    names_glue = "{test}_pval"
    )

setSize <- sapply(gs,length) |> as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("GENE.SET") |>
  dplyr::rename("SET.SIZE" = "sapply(gs, length)")

allPvals <- setSize |>
  dplyr::left_join(allPvals, by = "GENE.SET")
write.csv(allPvals, paste0(metadata_list["Analysis_Name"],"_all_pvals.csv"))
```

## Create and export visuals

```{r Visualizations}
######################################################################################
## Jitter plot                                                                      ##
######################################################################################

p <- resultDF |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = test,y=-log10(PVAL + 0.00001))) +
  ggplot2::geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.1) +
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 22) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dotted", col = "red") +
  ggplot2::guides(alpha= "none") +
  ggplot2::labs(y = "log10(pval)")

ggplot2::ggsave(paste0(metadata_list["Analysis_Name"],"_pval_distributions.png"), p,
                width = 14, units = "in")

######################################################################################
## Significant findings UpSet                                                       ##
######################################################################################
upsetDF <- resultDF |>
  dplyr::filter(PVAL < 0.05) |>
  dplyr::select(test, GENE.SET)
listInput<-lapply(upsetDF |> dplyr::pull(test) |> unique(),
                  function(x) {
                    upsetDF |> dplyr::filter(test==x) |> dplyr::pull(GENE.SET)
                  })

names(listInput) <- upsetDF |> dplyr::pull(test) |> unique()

if (length(listInput) > 0) {
  png(paste0(metadata_list["Analysis_Name"],"_upset.png"),width=10, height=7, units="in", res = 300)
  UpSetR::upset(UpSetR::fromList(listInput),text.scale = c(1.3, 1.3, 1.3, 1.3, 2, 1.3), nsets = 9)
  dev.off()
} else {
  message("No significant gene sets were detected at PVAL < 0.05; skipping UpSet plot export.")
}

######################################################################################
## Compound Boxplots                                                                ##
######################################################################################
significant_gs <- sort(unique(unlist(listInput)))

boxplot_frame <- data_numeric
rownames(boxplot_frame) <- data |>
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(compoundColumn)) |>
  as.matrix()

boxplotter <- function(compound) {
  boxplot_data <- data.frame(AUC = boxplot_frame[compound,],Pheno = as.factor(columnMeta$Phenotype)) 
  ggplot2::ggplot(boxplot_data,ggplot2::aes(x = Pheno, y = AUC, fill = Pheno)) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_jitter(width=.1) +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(compound) + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")
}


pdf(paste0(metadata_list["Analysis_Name"],"_significant_target-level_boxplots.pdf"))
lapply(significant_gs, function(x) {
  plist <- lapply(gs[[x]], boxplotter)
  n <- length(gs[[x]])
  nCol <- floor(sqrt(n))
  gridExtra::grid.arrange(grobs = plist, ncol = nCol,
                          top=grid::textGrob(x,gp=grid::gpar(fontsize=20,font=3)))
})
dev.off()
```
